# Relay
Relay is a personalized PDF and email delivery platform. It generates LaTeX PDFs from templates and CSV data, and automatically delivers them to an audience by email. It is open-source and runs locally on your machine.

## Key Features
- Dynamic LaTeX PDF Generation
- Local-first Processing
- SMTP / Amazon SES Email Integration
- Document Workflows and Tracking
